name: Gift of Ganesh
body:
Your worship of Ganesh as one his favored returns good fortune.

Prerequisite(s): Ganeshan, must worship Ganesh, character level 3, Rahasya racial trait

Benefit(s): You gain an additional rahasya.

Special: A monk may ignore the racial prerequisite as long as he meets all other prequisites in order to select this feat as a monk bonus feat.
